page.overview:
What is Tetsunotsutsumi?

Iron Bundle is a Future Paradox mechanical penguin-like Pokémon resembling Delibird. Its upper body is comprised of white metal, while its lower body is mostly red. It has two white "tufts" that resemble feathers upon its forehead, a small yellow mechanical beak, and its eyes are blue with black, digital sclera. It is small and plump, with a rounded belly; a luminous blue dot-like patch in the center appears as its "navel". It has two stubby, robotic oval-shaped arms (with black metallic undersides), and carries around a large orb-shaped tank made of a blue, crystalline, cryogenic substance, which it also attaches to its back as a type of sack. It has a large black tube with glowing blue segments running up its back, which attaches to its tank. Its feet are long, yellow, and vaguely talon-like, ending in two up-turned toes.

Though fierce as any Paradox Pokémon, Iron Bundle acts jolly around its trainer once captured. Like all Future Paradox Pokémon, it enters a "sleep mode" in which its glowing blue patches and pixilated eyes go dark.

Ancient writings allegedly describe the design and usage of machines resembling Iron Bundle, leading to speculation that it may have been built by a long-lost civilization.

With its Quark Drive ability, like all Future Paradox Pokémon, Iron Bundle can increase its Speed and highest stat when Electric Terrain is active, or if holding a Booster Energy. According to the paranormal magazine "Occulture", the spherical device Iron Bundle carries can fire ice blasts, which it uses as a form of propulsion when attached to its back.
